store.summary: Wi-Fi-free baby monitor over LoRa for two CardputerZero
store.description: Pair two CardputerZero devices fitted with the Cap LoRa-1262 by typing a 6-digit code. One device sits next to the baby and streams Codec2-compressed sound over encrypted LoRa when it hears something; the other plays it and shows a live waveform. No Wi-Fi or phone needed.
